description.value: Aurora Roasters is a specialty coffee café and small-batch roastery founded in Abbotsford in 2023, built around the idea that great things happen when good coffee is shared. The combined café and roastery lets visitors taste carefully sourced single-origin and blended coffees roasted on-site, alongside baked goods and kitchen specials. The team regularly hosts workshops, private tastings, and pop-up events, making it a lively stop for coffee-curious cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.
